description: Holy Spokes look at all this new tech! More than just exciting new colors and a new, 2 year motor warranty (an industry first!) The Mullet Pro Limited Edition is popping with new tech, too! Shimano Deore clutched derailleur to shift smoothly on the gnarliest trails, 42x10-50 tooth, 10 Speed Cassette with a broader gearing range for even easier top-speed performance and extreme climbs. New, high performance steering stems for more control, a new dropper seat that's standard on all Mullet models, a range of longer seat tubes for taller riders, improved 2nd generation HyperTek Gold coated forks tubes. Wow! All this without a price increase! ...and OK, yes, the new colors are awesome, too! Chalk, Arctic Gray, and Sky Blue Nothing comes close to Cyberbike's combination of price, power, light weight and quality.
